newsitem.title: USA: PAXAR offers cash for its 12.5 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: PAXAR offers cash for its 12.5 pct notes.

text.p: PAXAR Corp said Thursday that one its subsidiaries, Monarch Markings Systems Inc, has commenced a cash tender offer for all its 12.5 percent senior notes due 2003.

The redemption price has been set at the greater of $1,167.50 for each $1,000 of principal, or the present value of the notes determined on the basis of 75 basis points above the yield on the 6.75 percent U.S. Treasury Note due June 30, 1999. Monarch's offer will expire at 0000 EST/0500 GMT
Paxar is involved in the apparel identification business. Monarch is a leading supplier of identification and tracking solutions to retail and industrial customers.
